root_cause.text: The polling timeout in `bcm2835_asb_control()` was too short (1 microsecond), causing premature timeout under heavy workloads when the ASB bridge took longer to acknowledge, leading to failed power transitions and system instability.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "the timeout is insufficient in some scenarios, increase the polling timeout from 1us to 5us"; the patch changes the open-coded loop with a 1000 ns limit to `readl_poll_timeout_atomic()` with a timeout of 5 microseconds.
